integrity_notes: Mathematical proof is analytic. A supplied exact-rational checker tests finite instances but does not certify infinite cases. No independent mathematical audit has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Applies to stationary circle Poisson mixtures with positive Borel mixing law on \((0,1)\) and finite integral of \((1-r)^{-1}\). Does not cover nonsummable, signed, or nonstationary mixtures, general log-convex sequences, or higher-dimensional kernels. Priority beyond inspected sources is provisional.
title: A universal harmonic-positivity cutoff and spectral reopening for mixtures of circle Poisson kernels
